description:
## Why

Per the chain_walk decomposition design doc attached to PKIX-als9 (Section 5, Section 7), PKITS §4.5 — Verifying Paths with Self-Issued Certificates — is the single largest unmonitored regression class for the planned refactor. The current pkix-path/tests/ directory imports PKITS §4.1, §4.2, §4.3, §4.6, §4.7, §4.8, §4.9, §4.10, §4.11, §4.12, §4.13 but not §4.5.

## What §4.5 covers

PKITS §4.5 exercises is_self_issued_cert exemptions in three RFC 5280 sites:
- §6.1.3(b) — NameConstraints subject-name check skip for self-issued certs
- §6.1.4(h) — explicit_policy / policy_mapping / inhibit_any_policy counter-decrement skip
- §6.1.4(m) — pathLenConstraint counts only NON-self-issued certs

Without §4.5 coverage, refactor regressions in:
- H7 (check_intermediate_basic_constraints — pathLen counting)
- H10 (update_name_constraints_state — NC check skip on self-issued)
- H11 (finalise_policy_tree_with_user_set — counter behavior)
will not be caught.

## Action

1. Locate PKITS 04 archive (NIST PKITS 2.16.840.1.101.3.2.1.48.51) §4.5 test cases and CRLs.
2. Convert fixtures using the existing pkits_*.rs harness pattern (see pkits_4_6_4_7.rs).
3. Add tests to pkix-path/tests/pkits_4_5.rs.
4. External oracle: NIST PKITS expected results table (each test case has an expected pass/fail outcome documented in the PKITS specification).

## Constraints

- Tests must be fully offline (PKITS fixtures committed to repo).
- pkix-path is no_std; test harness can use std (pkix-path tests already use std for fixture loading).
- Independent oracle: NIST PKITS expected results — not the code under test.

## Acceptance

- pkix-path/tests/pkits_4_5.rs exists with all §4.5 test cases.
- All pass with current chain_walk implementation (regression-protective baseline).
- Block dependency added: PKIX-als9 PR-2 (H7+H9) and PR-3 (H8+H10+H11) should not land before this.
design:
## PKITS §4.5 self-issued path tests — scoping result

## §1 PKITS source
- Zip: https://csrc.nist.gov/CSRC/media/Projects/PKI-Testing/documents/PKITS_data.zip (HTTP 200, ~3.05 MB, last-modified 2024-09-29).
- PDF: https://csrc.nist.gov/CSRC/media/Projects/PKI-Testing/documents/PKITS.pdf (HTTP 200, ~5.03 MB).
- pkix-path/tests/pkits/README.md documents the layout.

## §2 §4.5 test cases (verbatim from PKITS, verdicts confirmed via vectors.json)
- 4.5.1 Valid Basic Self-Issued Old With New Test1 — PASS
- 4.5.2 Invalid Basic Self-Issued Old With New Test2 — FAIL
- 4.5.3 Valid Basic Self-Issued New With Old Test3 — PASS
- 4.5.4 Valid Basic Self-Issued New With Old Test4 — PASS
- 4.5.5 Invalid Basic Self-Issued New With Old Test5 — FAIL
- 4.5.6 Valid Basic Self-Issued CRL Signing Key Test6 — PASS
- 4.5.7 Invalid Basic Self-Issued CRL Signing Key Test7 — FAIL
- 4.5.8 Invalid Basic Self-Issued CRL Signing Key Test8 — FAIL

## §3 Existing harness
- pkix-path/tests/pkits_helper.rs (84 lines): pkits_cert(name), pkits_trust_anchor(), pkits_validate(&[leaf_first_names], now_unix) -> Result<ValidatedPath>. PKITS_NOW=1_577_836_800 (2020-01-01).
- Existing test files: pkits_4_1_4_2.rs (189), pkits_4_3.rs (147), pkits_4_6_4_7.rs (431), pkits_4_13.rs (726), pkits_policy.rs (1663), pkits_smoke.rs.
- Naming: `pkits_4_6_1_missing_basic_constraints` style.
- Verdict assertion: PASS uses `result.expect("§X must validate")`; FAIL uses `assert!(matches!(result, Err(Error::SpecificVariant{..})))` — variant-precise where possible.
- API: all call pkix_path::validate_path via pkits_validate. No pkix-chain.
- is_self_issued_cert exists at pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1438; already exercised by 4.6.15/16/17 and policy 4.8/4.9/4.11.

## §4 Fixture inventory — ALREADY COMMITTED
All 13 §4.5 certs and all 5 §4.5 CRLs are present in pkix-path/tests/pkits/{certs,crls}/. Zero new imports required.

## §5 Effort
- ~250-320 LOC for pkits_4_5.rs (extrapolating from §4.6/§4.7 boilerplate).
- No new helpers needed for pkix-path-only PASS subset.
- A pkits_validate_with_crls helper would be needed to run through pkix-revocation.
- Oracle: PKITS PDF Table 4 (Test Results), §4.5 entries.
- Total: ~3-5 hours pkix-path PASS-only; ~6-8 hours full pkix-revocation suite.

## §6 Critical: §4.5 splits across two crates

All 8 §4.5 vectors carry a CRLPath. The 4 FAIL cases (4.5.2, 4.5.5, 4.5.7, 4.5.8) FAIL **because** the EE is revoked on a self-issued-signed CRL. Per AGENTS.md (pkix-path is no_std, no revocation), the FAIL cases CANNOT live in pkix-path/tests/. Without revocation, those 4 tests would WRONGLY pass.

Required split:
- PR-1: pkix-path/tests/pkits_4_5.rs — 4 PASS cases (4.5.1, 4.5.3, 4.5.4, 4.5.6). Exercises the RFC 5280 §6.1.3(b) NC-skip and §6.1.4(h)/(m) counter/path-len exemptions for self-issued certs. ~150 LOC, ~2 hrs.
- PR-2: pkix-revocation/tests/pkits_4_5.rs — all 8 cases via a new pkits_validate_with_crls helper. ~250 LOC + ~50 LOC harness, ~5 hrs.

## §7 Risks
- Validity window: all BasicSelfIssued certs valid 2010-2030; PKITS_NOW=2020 is in-window.
- is_self_issued_cert correctness: textbook §3.3 implementation, already exercised by other PKITS sections; high confidence.
- chain_walk H7/H10/H11 linkage: §4.5 PASS cases will exercise these — tests must land BEFORE chain_walk refactor begins so refactor regressions are caught.

## §8 Recommendation
Proceed with the split:
1. PR-1 (pkix-path): 4 PASS cases. Lands first, blocks PKIX-als9 refactor PR.
2. PR-2 (pkix-revocation): 8 cases including FAIL via new harness. Independent of PR-1, can land in parallel with chain_walk refactor.
notes:
Both children completed:
- PKIX-77cl.1 (pkix-path PR): 5 tests in pkix-path/tests/pkits_4_5.rs covering structural cases 4.5.1, .3, .4, .6 (PASS) and .8 (FAIL — Test8EE signed by cRLSign-only self-issued cert lacking BasicConstraints).
- PKIX-77cl.2 (pkix-revocation PR): 7 tests in pkix-revocation/tests/pkits_4_5.rs covering revocation lens for 4.5.1-7.

Original bead description scoped 4 PASS to pkix-path and 4 FAIL to pkix-revocation. After reading the PKITS PDF §4.5 narrative, §4.5.8 turned out to be a path-validation failure (not revocation), so the corrected split is 5 structural in pkix-path / 7 revocation in pkix-revocation. All 12 tests pass; full workspace suite green.

Regression-protective baseline for the planned chain_walk decomposition is in place: §4.5.1, .3, .4, .6 PASS exercise §6.1.4(m) self-issued-cert path-length exemption.
title: Add PKITS §4.5 self-issued cert tests (fixtures already present; split across pkix-path PASS + pkix-revocation FAIL)
